figures.what_it_shows: Diffraction resolution d_min (Å) distribution of the 22 enrolled extreme-resolution X-ray control proteins, comparing actual d_min <= 0.90 Å (n=15) vs (0.90, 1.00] Å (n=7) against the stored cluster-inherited stratum flag (stratum=true n=20 vs false n=2).
figures.selection: 22 enrolled cluster representatives surviving Round-2 D3 (>=50 unmasked residues) and D6 two-path headroom screening out of 58 attempts (30 initial + 28 replacements).

figures.what_it_shows: Distribution of Round-9 regenerated null-refinement ΔR-free (post minus deposited baseline) across PHENIX model_vs_data (n=22), Gemmi sfcalc (n=22), and CCP4 REFMAC5 BREF ANIS (n=21, 9YGW absent).
figures.selection: 22 enrolled extreme-resolution control structures; 9YGW absent in REFMAC5 (n=21).

figures.what_it_shows: Paired per-PDB comparison on the common 21-structure subset (9YGW absent in REFMAC5) between REFMAC5 BREF ISOT (collapsing deposited ANISOU) and REFMAC5 BREF ANIS (preserving ANISOU on both sides), alongside common-subset PHENIX and Gemmi ΔR-free.
figures.selection: 21 REFMAC-measurable structures from the 22-entry cohort (9YGW excluded due to REFMAC absence).

figures.what_it_shows: Distribution of Round-10 multi-factor recovery (osol_h) ΔR-free relative to the deposited baseline across PHENIX (n=22), Gemmi (n=22), and REFMAC5 BREF ANIS (n=21, 9YGW absent). JSON retains delta values only.
figures.selection: 22 enrolled extreme-resolution control structures under Round-10 osol_h regimen (regenerated phenix.dynamics stop_at_diff=0.5 seed=42 + phenix.ready_set hydrogens + phenix.refine ordered_solvent=True hydrogens.refine=riding + REFMAC5 ANIS).

figures.what_it_shows: Bond-length RMSD (Å, not RMSZ) reconstructed from the committed 17-model benchmark table at published precision across A (phenix.model_statistics CDL), B (phenix.model_statistics E&H), and C (gemmi rmsz CCP4 monomer library, historical gemmi 0.7.4 per #502 disclosure), separating the n=6 equal-bond-count subset from the n=11 different-bond-count subset.
figures.selection: 17 deposited X-ray structures from tolerance_benchmark_restraint_library.md:38-56; 6 with equal restrained bond counts (9LLR, 9PN7, 30IZ, 12LO, 37AP, 37AS) and 11 with differing bond counts.

figures.what_it_shows: Paired comparison of PHENIX rotalyze vs wwPDB validation report rotamer outlier percentage across the n=41 protein entries in Round 46 (12CI nucleic-acid entry excluded for zero shared protein denominator), contrasting altloc denominator shifts on 14ZZ (-1.52 pp) and 2YOL (+0.57 pp) against 1.0000 shared-key binary OUTLIER agreement across all 41 proteins (38,744/38,744 residues).
figures.selection: 41 protein entries with positive shared rotamer denominators out of 42 total entries in ref/research/data/round46_vs_deposited.json (12CI excluded: rotamer_n_shared = 0).

figures.what_it_shows: Orthogonal evidence-state (8 states, n=41) and policy-state (7 states, n=41) counts across the 21 rendered threshold-registry rows (17 in §3 + 4 in §4) in ref/threshold_evidence_status.yaml, paired with the §6 FIT ΔR-free threshold registration history (unitless fraction, median_null + 3*max(MAD_null, 0.0005)) across R4 retired (ISOT, n=22/22/19), R7 history (ISOT with 8R5K clean null, n=22/22/20), and R9 current (REFI BREF ANIS, n=22/22/21).

figures.selection: All 21 rows (41 components) in ref/threshold_evidence_status.yaml (§3 and §4 scope) and all benched null ΔR-free observations in negative_control_round3_bench.json, negative_control_round6_hygiene.json (g3_8r5k_rescreen.clean_null_deltas), and negative_control_round9_anis.json (§6 scope).
